issues.evidence: results-canonical-regressions.json: prior release reports zero widget/text/raster changes in both controlled public cases; current code reports one document-level field change. pypdf independently confirms saved values, export/display mapping and absence of widgets in the unplaced case.
issues.limits: Document-level records coexist with widget records; counts are not additive. Changed-source interactive documents still require review.

issues.evidence: Six of 14 public form documents match the independent field inventory. Eight hybrid XFA documents explicitly return a canonical-analysis review reason and no canonical snapshots. SDK widget comparisons remain available.
issues.required: Compare the available AcroForm tree while separately reporting unverified XFA semantics; do not discard all ordinary fields solely because XFA is present.

issues.evidence: A malformed tree/string or unsupported stream-valued property currently prevents all canonical snapshots for that source, avoiding false deletions but reducing usable coverage.
issues.required: Add per-property/field availability and bounded text/action stream decoding so unrelated valid fields can still be compared; retain explicit uncertainty.

issues.evidence: Unreferenced orphan fields, signature verification, full action semantics, rich-text/default-appearance/resource normalization and AcroForm-level flags/calculation order are not fully modeled. Raw binary signature values are not signature verification.
issues.required: Extend independently checked coverage without marking changed-source interactive documents complete prematurely.

issues.evidence: lopdf 0.46.0 limits individual object/xref stream expansion to 8MiB, and the application limits source size, traversal depth/items and output work. These do not bound every internal parser allocation or total elapsed time.
issues.required: Add aggregate/process memory and time isolation for untrusted parsing/decoding; retain recoverable diagnostics and native/WASM parity.

implementation_profile.text_output_budget: min(max_input_mb MiB,64MiB), conservative charge for JSON escaping and repeated qualified name components
implementation_profile.normalization: Strict BOM-marked UTF-16BE and UTF-8; one-byte PDFDocEncoding rejects undefined scalars. Dictionary and field order normalized; reference identities resolved. Stored values retain literal Unicode/array order.
